The actual list is 'git ls-files specs/archive/' (5 paths). Force-tracking would change that count in the comment only.

Repo-wide grep found two citation sites the dispatch did not name: FormalSystem/Metalogic/Decidability/PlusSlicedCertificate/Limits/README.md:92 (elided probe paths + 'probe is retained as the provenance record') and scripts/decidability-inventory-baseline.txt:81-82 (repopath: records at the OLD live-task paths; the baseline is a recorded snapshot by its own header, not to be edited). Also found that the WIRED_REPO comment at check-evidence-probes.sh:687 ('live tasks (706, 710)') is the C9 task-number-citation hit CI reports; deleting/rewriting that block clears a second CI red in passing.

Correction to the earlier win entry: check-module-invariants.sh --no-build run locally at HEAD reports PASS C9 with check-evidence-probes.sh:687 ('live tasks (706, 710)') present, so that line is NOT the C9 hit CI reported at 1d06de5a5; the C9 claim is withdrawn. The two extra citation sites stand.
